text:
sam_support: FYI getting alerted by customer jane_acme about a sudden spike in 502/504s hitting the hosted API from us-east-1 → they see ~7% errors starting ~09:12 UTC :eyes:

jane_acme: seeing 502s in production, requests fail intermittently. sample request-id: req_20260318_9a3f. Happening for both streaming and non-streaming calls.

sam_support: repro curl they sent:
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \n  -H 'X-Tenant: acme' \n  -d '{"input":"hello"}' \n  https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate
```
response: HTTP/2 502, downstream_reset, upstream reset or no healthy upstream.

lina_sre: thanks — can you paste recent edge proxy envoy logs for that request-id and the health of upstream pods? also any deploys around 09:00-09:15 UTC?

sam_support: paste of relevant lines from edge-proxy (trimmed):
```
[09:12:33.123] envoy connflow: stream reset, stream_id=3421, reason=DOWNSTREAM_CONNECTION_TERMINATION, request_id=req_20260318_9a3f
[09:12:33.124] upstream reset: connection failure to 10.10.21.8: upstream_connection_failure
[09:12:33.125] healthcheck: endpoint=backend-model-1 pod=backend-1 unhealthy=false
```
(note: healthcheck showed endpoint healthy that minute)

tom_infra: seeing a pattern — authz service in front of the model-pool emitted a flurry of 429s to upstreams right before the 502s. Could be authz heartbeat/backpressure causing upstream conn drops.

marta_oncall: I see deploy-bot pushed a revision of authz-proxy @09:05 UTC (rev: authz-20260318-17). deploy-bot, can you confirm any rolling restart behavior? @deploy-bot

deploy-bot: deploy event: service=authz-proxy, revision=authz-20260318-17, started=2026-03-18T09:05:10Z, rollouts=5 pods, strategy=RollingUpdate

lina_sre: if authz pods were restarting while healthchecks reported briefly healthy, we could have transient connection ejections or half-open streams. Can you check envoy upstream_eject metrics and consecutive_5xx counters for the edge?

sam_support: ran quick query on metrics:
```
edge_upstream_ejects{region="us-east-1",service="authz-proxy"} => spike at 09:11:50 -> 09:13:00 (+22 ejects)
edge_5xx_count{route="/v1/generate"} => +680 in 3m window
```

tom_infra: that matches. Also note TLS renegotiation logs showed some `ALPN mismatch` messages around same time — could be client-side keepalive churn and conn pool thrash.

jane_acme: we didn't deploy anything. This started after your deploy apparently. We need a mitigation asap, customers on critical SLA.

marta_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) pin jane_acme traffic to fallback path (cached model variant) via routing rule, 2) temporarily increase authz-proxy replica min to avoid churn, 3) rollback authz-proxy revision if trend continues.

lina_sre: quick repro steps for SRE to gather traces: 1) curl with `-H 'X-Debug-Id: req_20260318_9a3f'` 2) gather `kubectl logs -l app=edge-proxy -n prod --since=10m | grep req_20260318_9a3f` and `kubectl get pods -l app=authz-proxy -o wide` 3) check envoy admin /clusters?format=json for hosts ejected and reason.

sam_support: did that and attached outputs to ticket INC-4627 (not in this thread). Summary: authz-proxy pods restarted 3x in 6m due to liveness probe sensitivity after the new image. Pod CPU spike coincided with rolling restarts.

tom_infra: root cause hypothesis: authz-proxy 20260318-17 introduced a small regression in token cache that increases CPU for certain tenants causing liveness restarts → upstream ejections → edge 502/504s.

marta_oncall: action items: (a) rollback authz-proxy to previous image (authz-20260311-09) — I'll coordinate, (b) add temporary routing fallback for acme tenant, (c) increase liveness probe timeout for authz-proxy until we fix token cache.

sam_support: notified customer jane_acme about mitigation steps and rollback plan. They asked for ETA — told them 20–30m.

lina_sre: after rollback we'll monitor edge_5xx_count and upstream_ejects for 15m. Also create postmortem if rollback confirms deploy regression.

jane_acme: thanks, appreciate the quick response. Please keep us updated. :pray: 

marta_oncall: rolling back now (tracking in CICD). I'll post when complete.

deploy-bot: rollback complete: service=authz-proxy, to_revision=authz-20260311-09, finished=2026-03-18T09:33:40Z

sam_support: post-rollback metrics at 09:40 UTC — edge_5xx_count back to baseline, upstream_ejects dropped to normal. Customer reports errors resolved. Closing for now but will open a formal postmortem.

lina_sre: create follow-up: add canary gating for authz-proxy CPU metric, increase liveness timeout, and add tenant-impact alert when edge_5xx_rate > 1% for top-50 tenants.

marta_oncall: noted. Good catch team. :thumbsup:
